name: What is the typical cost associated with re-listing an expired property?

mainEntity.name: What is the typical cost associated with re-listing an expired property?

acceptedAnswer.text: The costs for re-listing an expired property are generally similar to an initial listing, primarily comprising agent commissions paid at closing. There are typically no upfront fees to list with our team. However, you might choose to invest in pre-listing preparations such as professional staging, minor repairs, or enhanced photography to make your property more appealing. These investments are optional but can significantly impact the sale price and speed.
acceptedAnswer.description: Re-listing costs are similar to initial listings, mainly agent commissions at closing. Optional investments in staging or repairs can enhance marketability.
